newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei opens weaker below key 21,000 level.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei opens weaker below key 21,000 level.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened slightly lower on Friday, due to weaker sentiment carried over from the previous day.
The benchmark Nikkei average edged down below the key level of 21,000 but it is expected to be supported at around 20,700 to 20,750, brokers said.

About 10 minutes after the market opened, the 225-share Nikkei average was down 52.61 points, or 0.25 percent, at 20,982.93. In the stock futures market, the key December futures contract lost 60 points to 21,060.
Brokers said most foreign investors would be off today as it was Thanksgiving in the United States on Thursday, and that this would keep blue-chip issues from heading further upwards.
